title: Floral carpet (dark blue ground)
notes: Floral carpet (dark blue ground). late 18th century, Khanates Period, Azerbaijan. Türk ve İslam Eserleri Museum , Istanbul. Acquired 1912. inv. no 126 (1910) from Yeni Camii, Sivas, Turkey. 165 x 377 cm, fragment. published Serare Yetkin's "Early Caucasian carpets in Turkey", plate 61.
